description.en: Build Part 1 of an agentic RFP workflow: PDF upload via existing backend + uis/backoffice, store under data/raw/, persist tickets/metadata/key aspects in Postgres (Supabase), pipeline in data/pipelines/rfp_intake (MarkItDown, classifier, orchestrator-worker-synthesizer) — aligned to CONTEXT-company.md.
